Honestly I had the same problem with my sourdough for months. In my case it was the flour — the cheap one from the supermarket just doesn't have enough protein, so the dough never got any structure no matter how long I folded it.

Try a stronger bread flour first, it's the easiest fix. If that doesn't help I think the next suspect is your starter, mine was kind of weak because I kept it in the fridge too long.

Also don't trust the recipe times too much. My kitchen is cold so everything takes like twice as long, I just watch the dough now instead of the clock.
